Gemini API Rate Limits

The Gemini API uses a tiered system based on billing status.

Usage Tiers

TierDescription
Tier 1No billing required. Lower rate limits.
Tier 2Billing enabled. Higher rate limits.
Tier 3Highest rate limits for production workloads.
